title: Napoleonic Wars
description: Test your knowledge on the global conflicts fought during the reign of Napoleon Bonaparte.

questions.text: Who was the Emperor of the French during the Napoleonic Wars?
questions.explanationText: Napoleon Bonaparte rose to power during the French Revolution and crowned himself Emperor of the French in 1804.

questions.text: Which decisive naval battle in 1805 established British naval supremacy and prevented a French invasion of Britain?
questions.explanationText: The Battle of Trafalgar, led by Admiral Horatio Nelson, was a crucial British naval victory that ended French plans for invading Britain.

questions.text: In 1812, Napoleon launched a disastrous invasion of which country, leading to the collapse of the Grande Armée?
questions.explanationText: The invasion of Russia in 1812 was a major turning point, where the harsh winter and scorched-earth tactics destroyed most of Napoleon's army.

questions.text: What was the name of the system of trade embargoes Napoleon established to exclude Britain from continental European trade?
questions.explanationText: The Continental System was the foreign policy of Napoleon I of France in his struggle against Great Britain during the Napoleonic Wars.

questions.text: At which final battle in 1815 was Napoleon definitively defeated by the Seventh Coalition?
questions.explanationText: The Battle of Waterloo, fought in present-day Belgium, was Napoleon's final defeat and ended his rule as Emperor.
